create_thinking_strategy: create a ThinkingStrategy enum to configure synchronous or asynchronous thinking intervals for a robotics policy
build_thinking_manager: build a ThinkingManager to query a Gemini model for thinking responses based on robot observations and a strategy
build_multi_thinking_manager: build a MultiThinkingManager to aggregate thinking responses from multiple ThinkingManager instances with different strategies
review_thinking_strategy_should_think: review the ThinkingStrategy should_think method to determine when the model should think based on time step and interval
refactor_thinking_manager_query: refactor the ThinkingManager _query_thinking method to convert observations into model query contents and generate responses
